items.title: bge-small embedding model (semantic search)
items.description: The sentence-embedding model behind semantic search: 384 dimensions, 37 MB at q8_0, served by llama-server with --embedding on port 8091 (install/systemd/sos-embed.service). A query is embedded on the box in about 25 ms; the library's passages are embedded on the PC by sos build-embeddings (the embeddings-docs item). sha256 ec38e8da142596baa913124ae50550de284b6916bf59577ef2f0cb9660c2f514.

items.title: Semantic index of the box's own library
items.licence: Derived from the library's own text
items.description: docs.f16.bin, docs.ids and docs.meta.json: one 384-dimensional vector per passage of the guides, quick cards, modules, pages and converted documents (some 21,000), written on the PC by `sos build-embeddings` with the bge-small-en-v1.5 model (https://huggingface.co/CompendiumLabs/bge-small-en-v1.5-gguf, sha256 ec38e8da142596baa913124ae50550de284b6916bf59577ef2f0cb9660c2f514) and copied into core/embeddings. Rebuild after `sos index` changes the library. Without it search is the keyword search alone.

items.title: Semantic index of the household library (Gutenberg, Survivor Library)
items.licence: Derived from Gutenberg's and Survivor Library's own text
items.description: household.hnsw, household.ids and household.meta.json: one 384-dimensional vector per real book across Project Gutenberg and Survivor Library, an approximate-nearest-neighbour hnswlib index built on the PC by `sos build-embeddings` with the bge-small-en-v1.5 model and copied into core/embeddings. Rebuild after either ZIM changes. Without it the household collection is not searchable by meaning, only by keyword.
